verdict.rationale: First-party docs say you don't need to build the whole page in React: you can add it to an existing HTML page or stack and render interactive components anywhere, without rewriting (react-docs-1, react-docs-12, react-gh-3). createRoot mounts components into any browser DOM node, and components update the screen in response to interactions (react-docs-8, react-docs-3). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of embedding into a legacy server-rendered page, and concrete setup detail for that scenario (the docs elsewhere point to build tools and JSX compilation).
